summary: Under a minute of the window remained, so this is a no-change close: the record is complete and verified, and any edit at that point could not have been written and validated safely. The run's substance is in place — the main finding is a classification gap in the inbound filter (MsgForgetLeader absent from isLocalMsg, so a peer-form message is accepted through both documented inbound paths, clears a follower's live leader context with either an unset or a legal term, defeats the CheckQuorum lease that would otherwise withhold its pre-vote, and can carry an up-to-date candidate to leadership at a higher term while the incumbent still serves), reproduced by a repeat and bounded by measurement at both ends: the incumbent ends its own leadership within one election timeout when it hears from nobody, and the aftermath shows the deposed incumbent conceding with its committed prefix intact. The two boundary questions around it are refuted rather than asserted, each with its own basis, and the last turns closed the remaining gaps: the marker's effect is measured on the receiving side; the transfer chain is measured end to end and corrected (the incumbent's cost is its term and its leadership, not its ballot); the claim that the lease suppressed both requests now cites the two events witnessing it; the higher-term shape is no longer listed as unmeasured; and a synthesis entry states in one place how the lease can be moved aside and what it costs. Every cited receipt exists with every cited index in range, every cited source is a captured material, no execution is uncited, no question lacks an interpretation, and there are no open gaps.
